thread:
Priya K.: urgent ticket from Acme - their A/B rollout dashboard shows control=70%, treatment=30% but raw event telemetry is ~50/50. Customer very confused, asked for explanation. any ideas? :thinking_face:
Sam R.: seeing the same anomaly on our internal 'fast-path' canary. looks like labels got mixed on the dashboard level rather than events. pinging @Kevin L. to check analytics pipeline. :rotating_light:
Kevin L.: I can dig in. Did this start after the analytics deploy last night? deploy-bot: deployed version analytics-service@2026.03.16-1 (build 20260316001) to analytics-cluster at 1866999000
Maya S.: Customer attached screenshot and raw event sample. they included the assignment events payload for a few user_ids. pasted sample below:
```
{
  "user_id": "u_8741",
  "assignment": {"experiment": "fast-path", "variant": "control", "namespace": ""},
  "timestamp": "2026-03-16T22:42:11Z"
}
```
Priya K.: repro steps I ran locally: query raw events -> group by `concat(namespace,":",variant)` -> count. dashboard uses `assignment_key` which is computed in the materialized view. when namespace is empty the concat produced ":control" which apparently collides with other keys that had explicit 'prod:' prefix.
Sam R.: aha, so empty namespace became a leading colon and merged with keys that were prefixed. that would flip counts if one side had many null namespaces.
Kevin L.: looking at commit abc1234 (2026-03-16) in analytics-repo: we changed normalize_key to always do `${namespace}:${variant}` to standardize. previously we skipped separator for empty namespace. commit link: https://git.internal/r/analytics/commit/abc1234. this explains it.
Priya K.: reproducer SQL I used:
```
SELECT
  CASE WHEN namespace IS NULL OR namespace = '' THEN variant ELSE namespace || ':' || variant END AS assignment_key,
  count(1) as cnt
FROM events.assignment
WHERE experiment = 'fast-path' and ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cnt desc;
```
Kevin L.: quick mitigation: patch normalize_key to be null-safe, and backfill the materialized view to rebuild assignment_key for last 30 days. I'll prepare a hotfix PR and a backfill script.
Sam R.: propose rolling canary to analytics-prod with the patch, then run the MV rebuild on a staging copy first to estimate time. if backfill is heavy we can do incremental corrections for affected experiments.
Maya S.: customer asked what they should expect and how to validate when fixed. suggested steps: 1) we will update them when counts are recomputed, 2) provide SQL they can run (Priya's query above), 3) offer to run a custom backfill for their org if needed.
Kevin L.: hotfix PR created: https://git.internal/r/analytics/pull/542 - change is
```
- return `${namespace}:${variant}`;
+ if (!namespace) return variant;
+ return `${namespace}:${variant}`;
```
